command:
cd /app && python3 -c "
import json, pandas as pd, re, pyarrow.parquet as pq
t = pq.read_table('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print('parquet schema:'); print(t.schema)
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print(df.dtypes); print(df.to_string())
assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) == 'int64', df['user_id'].dtype
assert df['user_id'].is_unique
assert df['created_date'].map(lambda v: bool(re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', str(v)))).all()
rep = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
print('total_conflicts:', rep['total_conflicts'], 'len:', len(rep['conflicts']))
assert rep['total_conflicts'] == len(rep['conflicts'])
for c in rep['conflicts']:
    assert c['selected'] is not None
    assert 'source_a' in c['values'] or 'source_b' in c['values'] or 'source_c' in c['values']
print('OK: outputs valid')
"
